niko: Quick share: ran a focused prefill+speculative matrix on ember-7b-q (lut=v1/v2) to probe long-form summarization fidelity. TL;DR: 1.5-1.9x token throughput, but ~2.2% ROUGE-L drop on news-summary when lut=v2 + aggressive spec.

marta: can you paste sweep params and a couple diffs?

niko: key knobs: prefill_mode=chunked(1024), speculative=hard/soft, early_conf=[0.65,0.8], min_tokens=[0,3], lut_pass=[v1,v2]. repro:
```
./run_spec_expt --model ember-7b-q --dataset news-summary --seeds 42,43 --prefill chunked --chunk_size 1024 --spec_modes soft,hard --early_conf 0.65,0.8 --min_tokens 0,3 --lut v1,v2 --n_samples 500
```

harper: how are you computing ROUGE? tokenized or detokenized? need consistency for comparisons.

niko: used fast tokenized ROUGE for the sweep. agree to rerun detokenized official script for regression cases.

zain: failure modes: truncation at chunk boundaries when speculative exits early, plus lut=v2 nudging probs toward high-freq tokens -> generic short endings. diffs in artefact.

marta: propose checks: (1) detokenized ROUGE baseline (no spec), (2) spec with min_tokens=4, (3) lut v2 with bias-correction. capture per-token entropy traces.

niko: plan: A) baseline detok ROUGE (no spec, n=1000), B) spec sweep with min_tokens=4 (n=500), C) bias-corrected lut v2 (n=500). set kv_warmup=64 to standardize. ETA ~5-6h on shared pool.

zain: can queue dedicated 2xA100 to speed up; note kv-warmup ramp may change perf numbers slightly.

infra-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-artifacts/eng-ml/1761112223/prefill_spec_matrix.tar.gz (sha256: d4e5f6a7b8c9)

harper: small ask: include a minimal script to reproduce single counterexample in the notebook so we can test fixes quickly.

marta: and capture NLL curves + cumulative token dropout per-chunk so we can plot early-exit concentration. if chunk-edge bias shows up, consider chunk overlap or raising early_conf at edges.

niko: will post NLL traces and a short notebook with regen examples when runs finish. tagging infra for capture. :rocket:
